useful_god.rationale: Day Master Metal is strong; Water balances the chart.

errors.message: House system 'placidus' is undefined at latitude -77.8419. Beyond the polar circles the diurnal arc does not divide; use house_system='whole_sign', which is defined at every latitude.

yogas.name: Gaja-Kesari
yogas.reason: Jupiter is in the 7th sign from the Moon.

yogas.name: Budha-Aditya
yogas.reason: Sun and Mercury are both in Sagittarius.

yogas.name: Chandra-Mangala
yogas.reason: Moon is in Capricorn and Mars in Taurus; Chandra-Mangala needs both in the same sign.

yogas.name: Ruchaka
yogas.reason: Mars is in Taurus, neither its own sign (Aries, Scorpio) nor its exaltation sign (Capricorn).

yogas.name: Bhadra
yogas.reason: Mercury is in Sagittarius, neither its own sign (Gemini, Virgo) nor its exaltation sign (Virgo).

yogas.name: Hamsa
yogas.reason: Jupiter is exalted in Cancer but in the 6th house from the Lagna; Hamsa needs a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house). From the Moon it is in the 7th sign, a kendra — the condition holds only from the Moon.

yogas.name: Malavya
yogas.reason: Venus is in Sagittarius, neither its own sign (Taurus, Libra) nor its exaltation sign (Pisces).

yogas.name: Sasa
yogas.reason: Saturn is in its own sign Capricorn but in the 12th house from the Lagna; Sasa needs a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house). From the Moon it is in the 1st sign, a kendra — the condition holds only from the Moon.

yogas.name: Harsha
yogas.reason: The 6th house is Cancer; its lord Moon is in the 12th house.

yogas.name: Sarala
yogas.reason: The 8th house is Virgo; its lord Mercury is in the 11th house; Sarala needs the 6th, 8th or 12th.

yogas.name: Vimala
yogas.reason: The 12th house is Capricorn; its lord Saturn is in the 12th house.

yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga
yogas.reason: No planet is in its debilitation sign.

yogas.name: Sunapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Aquarius): none; 12th from the Moon (Sagittarius): Mercury and Venus (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Anapha
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Aquarius): none; 12th from the Moon (Sagittarius): Mercury and Venus (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Durudhara
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Aquarius): none; 12th from the Moon (Sagittarius): Mercury and Venus (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Kemadruma
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Moon (Aquarius): none; 12th from the Moon (Sagittarius): Mercury and Venus (Sun, Rahu and Ketu do not count); Kemadruma means both are empty.

yogas.name: Vesi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Capricorn): Saturn; 12th from the Sun (Scorpio): none (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Vasi
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Capricorn): Saturn; 12th from the Sun (Scorpio): none (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Ubhayachari
yogas.reason: 2nd from the Sun (Capricorn): Saturn; 12th from the Sun (Scorpio): none (Moon, Rahu and Ketu do not count).

yogas.name: Subha Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: none. Subha Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Papa Kartari
yogas.reason: Natural malefics (Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu) in the 2nd house: none; in the 12th: Saturn and Rahu. Papa Kartari needs both houses occupied by them (the Moon is not counted).

yogas.name: Parivartana
yogas.reason: No two planets stand in each other's signs.

yogas.name: Mangal Dosha
yogas.reason: Mars is 4th from the Lagna, 5th from the Moon and 6th from Venus; the dosha houses are the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th and 12th.

yogas.name: Kala Sarpa
yogas.reason: Planets lie on both sides of the Rahu–Ketu axis: Moon and Mars on one, Sun, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn on the other.

yogas.name: Amala
yogas.reason: Natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in the 10th from the Lagna (Scorpio): none; in the 10th from the Moon (Libra): none.

yogas.name: Dhana
yogas.reason: The 5th lord Mercury and the 9th lord Venus are linked: Mercury and Venus are both in Sagittarius.

yogas.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati
yogas.reason: The 9th lord Venus (Sagittarius) and the 10th lord Mars (Taurus) share no sign, mutual aspect or sign exchange.
